info.title: Kling 4.0 Image Generation Task - Submit Task
info.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 text-to-image or image-to-image task via `/kling/image-generation`. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); the related parameters are not supported yet.

post.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 text-to-image or image-to-image task via `/kling/image-generation`. The single-image mode can generate multiple independent images via `n`. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); the related parameters are not supported yet.

contents.text: Generate a 3D animation style character poster, warm lighting, simple background.
Using the puppy in @dog as the main character, generate a 3D animation style story image of the puppy sitting by the cafe window. Keep the puppy's coat color, appearance, and visual style consistent.

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

type.description:
Material type. Supported values: prompt, reference image, element.

Enum: `prompt` / `refer_image` / `element`

Materials must include a prompt; `prompt` is required and must not be empty.

Images and elements total at most 10; the prompt does not count toward this limit.

Note: Elements (`element`) are not yet integrated and cannot be used.

text.description:
Text prompt. Required and must not be empty; may include both positive and negative descriptions.

You can template the prompt to meet different image generation needs.

Prompt length: up to 50,000 characters for pure English, 21,000 characters for pure non-English; mixed input must satisfy: English characters/50000 + non-English characters/21000 ≤ 1.

Reference images or elements can be referenced with `@<id>`.

The JSON definition is as follows:

```json
{ "type": "prompt", "text": "string" }
```

url.description:
Accepts an image URL or Base64 content. The URL must be accessible and the value must not be empty.

Supported image formats: .jpg / .jpeg / .png.

Each image file must be under 30 MB, at least 300 px in width and height, with an aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2.

The JSON definition is as follows:

```json
{
  "type": "refer_image",
  "url": "string", // Image URL or Base64 content
  "id": "string" // Material index ID, referenced in the prompt via @<id>
}
```

element_id.description:
Element ID generated by the system, required when `type=element`. You can retrieve it via the element query API. Note: Elements are not yet integrated; this parameter is not supported yet.

Only multi-image elements (created from images) are supported. Different element types have different applicable scopes, so distinguish them carefully.

The number of reference images plus the number of elements must not exceed 10.

For more official element information, see: [Element library](https://app.klingai.com/cn/dev/document-api/apiReference/model/customElements).

The JSON definition is as follows:

```json
{
  "type": "element",
  "element_id": "string", // Element ID retrieved via the element query API
  "id": "string" // Material index ID, referenced in the prompt via @<id>
}
```

id.description: Material index ID, used to specify in the prompt; this parameter must not be repeated in the same task.

Kling4Settings.description: Parameters related to output configuration, such as resolution and aspect ratio.

result_type.description: Result type. Only `single` (independent images) is currently supported; generate multiple images with `n`.

n.description: Number of independent images to generate. Optional; value range: [1,9].

resolution.description:
Image resolution.
- `2k`: 2K HD
- `4k`: 4K HD
- `8k`: 8K ultra HD

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. `auto` means the ratio is determined from the input.

Kling4Options.description: General configuration, such as the callback URL and whether to include a watermark.

callback_url.description: Callback URL for task results. When configured, the server notifies you whenever the task status changes. See the [Callback protocol](https://app.klingai.com/global/dev/document-api/api/get-started/callbacks) for the notification message schema.

external_task_id.description:
Custom task ID.
- It does not override the system-generated task ID, but can be used to query the task
- Must be unique per user

enabled.description: true generates, false does not; defaults to false.

code.description: Error code; 0 means success. See the error code documentation for details.

request_id.description: Request tracking ID generated by the system for troubleshooting.

id.description: System task ID generated by the platform.

status.description: Task status: submitted, processing, succeeded, or failed.

create_time.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

update_time.description: Task update time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

external_id.description: Custom task ID specified at creation, if any.
